text:
Revenue for a customer: sum of order_total from orders joined to customers by name. Group by customer_id beside the name.

SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(o.order_total) AS total_revenue
FROM jaffle_shop.dev.customers c
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE LOWER(c.customer_name) = LOWER('Ryan Byrd')
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
